svg.title: VALTHVN OS — Valentin’s personal desktop
svg.desc: A mint and cream retro desktop. Valentin: vibe coder and open-source contributor, building web applications, tools and APIs. An original pixel bird beside a terminal: make it useful, make it simple, keep shipping. Project links follow below.
